label: Agreed provisional PDX design load
status: User-agreed engineering assumptions; not measured currents or ASMedia guarantees
application: USB4 40 Gb/s bridge with one PCIe Gen4 x4 endpoint

VCCH_VCCA33.scope: Combined bridge-only allowance; flash, pull-ups, supervisor, programming power and slot loads are additional

basis.VCCL_VDD: User accepted budgets of 1 A and 3 A from the PDX reference supply sizing. These are project loads, not measured or guaranteed chip currents.
basis.VCCH_VCCA33: User accepted a combined 100 mA project allowance. ASMedia supplies no verified maximum or split for these two nets.
basis.voltageSource: datasheets/ASM2464PDX_DataSheet_R0_3.pdf section 6.2: retain 1.9 V VCCL and 1.13 V VDD despite older schematic labels.

supersedes: Earlier 0.6 A VCCL, 2.3 A VDD and combined 50 mA VCCH/VCCA33 planning case. PD current figures remain historical comparisons.
limitations: Idle current, actual current steps and startup demand remain unknown.
The 100 mA combined 3.3 V allowance does not specify its split between VCCH and VCCA33.
The 3 A VDD budget uses the full nominal continuous regulator rating. Thermal derating and loaded startup require hardware checks.
The separate conductor screen retains 3 A on both rails and the 8 mV project limit. Its existing findings remain open.
Earlier reports use lower loads. Their results do not validate these budgets. New electrical results require new checks.
Transient sweeps apply assumed 10%, 25%, 50% and 100% steps of the selected design load, in both directions. They do not establish the bridge's actual load spectrum.
